rulesProfile.frontFormat: 6 lines: title, description, decision, option A/B/C
rulesProfile.instantOptionModel: 3 option results are instant, resolve once, then ignored for the rest of the game.
rulesProfile.rearModel: Persistent rear powers: controller uses On Activation action; secondary auto-triggers on activation.

costRules.cannotPay: If cost cannot be paid, effect does not happen.
costRules.negativeEffectsCost: Negative effects never have a cost.

combatResolutionNotes.fortified: A FORTIFIED token may be discarded to negate one hit taken by that fleet.
combatResolutionNotes.exposed: An EXPOSED token is discarded when that fleet next takes a hit; that fleet then takes one additional hit.
combatResolutionNotes.jammed: A JAMMED token prevents fleet movement and is discarded at END of turn.
combatResolutionNotes.vantage: At combat start, a side may discard a VANTAGE token to win draw outcomes; if both sides discard VANTAGE, they cancel out.

rulesProfile.balanceCurve: Power scales by deck tier (empty < system < phenomena) and trends stronger in late deck positions.
rulesProfile.specialRule: At least one card primary can retrigger a previously resolved instant option effect.

keywordGlossaryRules.SALVAGE: Gain the listed Credits from this effect immediately; this does not place a token unless the effect says it does.
keywordGlossaryRules.SCOUT: Reveal 1 adjacent unrevealed hex immediately. If no adjacent unrevealed hex exists, this effect does nothing.
keywordGlossaryRules.ANCHOR: A Fleet entering this card's cell may not be activated to move again this turn.
keywordGlossaryRules.OVERCHARGE: Gain the listed bonus immediately. Apply the listed drawback at END of this turn unless that effect says otherwise.
keywordGlossaryRules.FORTIFY: Take a FORTIFIED token. You may discard this token to negate a hit you have taken.
keywordGlossaryRules.JAMMED: Take a JAMMED token. A JAMMED Fleet cannot move. Discard this token at END of turn.
keywordGlossaryRules.EXPOSED: Take an EXPOSED token. Next time you take a hit, discard this token and take an extra hit.
keywordGlossaryRules.STABILIZE: Reduce Cosmic Tension by 1 immediately, to a minimum of 0 unless another rule states otherwise.
keywordGlossaryRules.DRIFTMARK: Take a DRIFTMARK token and place it on the card/hex specified by the effect.
keywordGlossaryRules.BEACONNET: You have BEACONNET while you control at least two Beacon cards/tokens linked by your controlled path.
keywordGlossaryRules.TRADECHAIN: You have TRADECHAIN while you control a continuous route of trade-enabled cards between two controlled points.
keywordGlossaryRules.RELAY: Take a RELAY token. You may discard that token at any time to extend an effect's range by 1.
keywordGlossaryRules.VANTAGE: Take a VANTAGE token. At the start of any future combat you may discard it; your Fleets win any draws, even if the other side would normally win. If both sides play VANTAGE, they cancel out.
keywordGlossaryRules.SURGE: After resolving the main effect, immediately resolve one additional listed beneficial sub-effect.
keywordGlossaryRules.RECOVERY: After this effect fully resolves, gain 1 Energy.
keywordGlossaryRules.TRIGGER-ECHO: Choose one already-resolved instant option on this card and resolve it again.
